target_customer: Health-conscious consumers who would buy an at-home blood test and ongoing biomarker tracking
problem: Routine blood panels measure few biomarkers and are taken rarely, so people cannot see molecular change in the body early. Helios wants one drop of blood to yield more than 1,000 biomarkers.
business_model: Consumer at-home test kits, likely repeat purchase or subscription (pricing not disclosed)
product_category: At-home molecular diagnostics and AI health model

founders.name: Omar Abudayyeh
education: PhD training at the Broad Institute and MIT
previous_startups: Sherlock Biosciences (acquired by OraSure, per YC page)
Proof Diagnostics (acquired by Ginkgo Bioworks, per YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page says he co-founded seven biotech companies that raised over $400M.

founders.name: Jonathan Gootenberg
education: BA Biological Engineering and Mathematics, MIT
founders.background_notes: Co-directs the Abudayyeh-Gootenberg Lab per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Reading more than 1,000 biomarkers from a finger-prick drop at home, then modelling them with AI, needs proteomics assay and sample-handling breakthroughs plus validated clinical interpretation. Product HeliosOne is listed as coming soon, so it was unshipped at the batch.

defensibility.rationale: Founders are Harvard faculty with published proteomics work per their site, which is hard to copy. Longitudinal data could compound, but nothing is shipped yet.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Too early to say; the company was newly in the Fall 2026 batch. Competitors named here come from general knowledge of the category, not from a dated source, so treat as unsourced.

market_need_then: The company's own pitch is earlier risk detection and personal performance tracking. No dated demand evidence was found beyond the pitch.

branding.domain_note: Uses heliosinc.ai; the exact .com history is unknown.

identity.visual_style: Cream and cypress colour scheme, minimal

branding.brand_signature: Tagline Expanding the Frontier of Humanity

brand_strength.rationale: Pre-launch; the name is shared with many unrelated Helios companies (supply chain AI, policy AI, quantum), which search results confirmed.

outcome_analysis: Helios is an active Fall 2026 YC company with five people and no shipped product, so no outcome exists yet. Its strength is founder market fit: two Harvard faculty with prior diagnostics exits. The main risks are the technical difficulty of a one drop, 1,000 biomarker assay and the regulatory and validation path for a consumer test.
notes: Funding unverified: Dealroom shows a $125k seed backed by Y Combinator and Formation VC, single aggregator, not recorded as a round. The company site says the seed is backed by YC and Formation with angels, no amounts. The site says its founders raised over $300M across companies while the YC page says over $400M. Outcome search found no shutdown or acquisition (results were other Helios entities). No competitor source dated near the batch was found, so the list is empty. Founder names come from the YC page; a Russian-language report also names them.
